title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government has responded to a report on artificial intelligence and public standards, outlining its position and plans for developing and regulating AI technology. The response aims to address the concerns and recommendations made in the original report while also informing the public about the government's AI strategy.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education has issued a policy on using generative AI in education, outlining its position on this technology. However, the content is not specified within the provided title information alone.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: This document describes Ofqual's approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in qualifications, and was created in response to pressure from government officials. It outlines how Ofqual will manage the development and use of artificial intelligence in qualifications, such as exams and grading.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This report examines the use of copyrighted works in the development of artificial intelligence systems. It aims to assess the potential impact of copyright law on the use of copyrighted materials in AI development.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has issued a formal response to a report by the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence, highlighting steps they plan to take regarding the technology. The policy focuses on addressing potential issues and risks associated with AI and implementing measures to improve the technology's positive impact in the UK.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference and frequently asked questions for a committee review of artificial intelligence and its impact on public standards. The review aims to provide guidance on how artificial intelligence should align with public standards and values.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The Centre for Data Ethics and Innovation has submitted evidence to a parliamentary inquiry about how to govern Artificial Intelligence. The submission likely outlines recommendations to ensure AI is developed and used responsibly.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This document explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) affects the regulation and approval of medical products. The document discusses implementing principles outlined in the AI White Paper to achieve better regulation in this area.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the Defence organisation the most effective and efficient in the world, while also being trusted and influential. It seeks to achieve this vision by leveraging technology in artificial intelligence.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport artificial intelligence action plan outlines how the Department for Transport will work with the transport sector to utilise and control the opportunities and risks of artificial intelligence. It aims to ensure the safe and effective use of AI in the transport industry.
